landing.page_title: Relay — Put AI agents to work on your own computers
landing.headline: Put AI agents to work on your own computers
landing.lede: Relay gives coding agents names, roles, and a shared record. Hand them threads, tasks, and automations, watch every command as it runs, and decide what ships.
landing.hero_alt: A Relay thread: one agent has fixed a bug and handed it to a second agent, whose review is streaming live
landing.step_enroll_body: Install Relay on a laptop or a managed server. Agents run on the computer you connect, directly or in a BoxLite sandbox, never inside the Relay backend.
landing.step_assign_body: Start a thread, file a task, or schedule an automation. Send it to one agent, or to a team that builds, reviews, and hands off.
landing.step_review_body: Follow reasoning, commands, and file changes live. When an agent needs a decision, the task waits for you.
landing.product_title: Everything your agents do, in one place
landing.tour_projects_body: Bring a shared workspace and a roster of agents together on one computer. Every task moves across one board from backlog to done.
landing.tour_projects_alt: A Relay project board from backlog to done
landing.tour_tasks_body: One list across projects, with queues for what needs you, what is blocked, and what is overdue. Every run and output file stays with its task.
landing.tour_tasks_alt: The Relay tasks list grouped by project
landing.tour_automations_body: Recurring work on a schedule or triggered by events. Relay dispatches each run to its assignee and keeps the history.
landing.tour_automations_alt: The Relay automations list with cadence and next run
landing.tour_teams_body: Group agents into Solo, Build → Review, Pipeline, or Lead-led teams. Roles and handoffs are explicit, so you always know who did what.
landing.tour_teams_alt: A Relay team profile with members and responsibilities
landing.principle_local_body: Agents run on connected local or cloud computers. The Relay backend coordinates their work and records the results.
landing.principle_human_body: Agents can ask structured questions when they need your input. Review results, accept completed work, or request changes.
landing.principle_record_body: Review requests, runs, generated files, and token usage together in the thread history.
landing.principle_runtime_body: Claude Code, Codex, Pi, and Kimi run side by side. Pin a model per agent and let each computer report what it supports.
landing.oss_title: Read it, run it, change it
landing.oss_body: Relay is open source under MIT. Self-host the backend, connect your own computers, and follow development on GitHub.
landing.cta_title: Give your agents a place to work
landing.cta_body: Relay is opening to teams in batches. Request access, or sign in if you already have an account.
landing.cta_body_signin: Sign in to your Relay account to start a thread.
landing.foot_tagline: The control plane for your AI workforce

recovery.title: Next steps
recovery.report_gone_body: Only do this after you confirm on the computer that the agent is no longer running. Relay records your report, marks the run cancelled, and lets the thread be deleted. This does not stop a running process and cannot be undone.
recovery.deletion_pending: Deletion pending. Relay finishes it once the agent has stopped and results are saved.
recovery.action_failed: Recovery failed. Try again. If it keeps failing, send this thread’s link to an administrator.
recovery.retry_requested: Recovery requested. The status will update shortly.
recovery.gone_reported: Reported. You can delete the thread now.
recovery.unblock_help: Fix the cause, save your changes, then select Unblock on the task board. Unblock restores the previous stage without running the agent. Work that was running returns to Awaiting input, where you can resume it.

finalization_failed.title: Results could not be saved
finalization_failed.body: Relay has the result but could not save it. Retry saving. If it fails again, ask an administrator to check backend storage. This does not rerun the agent.

missing_terminal_evidence.title: The run’s result was lost
missing_terminal_evidence.body: The computer’s exit report never reached Relay, so there is nothing to save. If the agent has stopped, report it as gone to release the thread.

termination_unconfirmed.title: Stop not confirmed
termination_unconfirmed.body: The stop has not been confirmed. Ask the computer owner to check the agent process. If the computer is gone for good, report the agent as gone so the thread can be deleted. Do not start replacement work until this is resolved.

orphaned_run.title: Execution needs reconciliation
orphaned_run.body: This thread shows a running agent, but Relay has no matching run record. Ask an administrator to reconcile it. If the run is definitely over, report the agent as gone.

online_exit_unconfirmed.title: Computer online, agent stop unconfirmed
online_exit_unconfirmed.body: The computer is connected, but Relay has not confirmed the agent stopped. Check the agent and its child processes on the computer. Relay keeps the run and any pending deletion until the stop is confirmed and results are saved.

execution_unconfirmed.title: Computer is not responding
execution_unconfirmed.body: Check the assigned computer and reconnect it. The agent may still be running. Relay cannot release the run or finish deletion until the computer confirms the agent stopped. If the computer is not coming back, report the agent as gone.

execution_lost.title: Computer has been offline too long
execution_lost.body: The assigned computer stopped responding and has not come back. If you know the computer is gone or the agent has stopped, report the agent as gone. Otherwise, reconnect the computer.

execution_interrupted.title: Computer restarted during this run
execution_interrupted.body: The computer’s Relay client restarted during this run and will not resume it. Check the workspace for partial work, then report the agent as gone before starting a new run.

awaiting_dispatch.title: Waiting to start
awaiting_dispatch.body: The request is queued. If it keeps waiting, check that the computer is online and has capacity. Do not submit the same work again.

awaiting_termination.title: Waiting for the agent to stop
awaiting_termination.body: Relay asked the agent to stop and is waiting for the computer to confirm. If it stalls, check the computer connection.

saving_results.title: Saving results
saving_results.body: Relay is saving results and cleaning up. No new run is needed. If saving keeps failing, a retry option appears.

unknown.title: Cause unknown
unknown.body: Relay has no recorded cause. Check the related run or ask the computer owner to investigate.

assignment.title: Check the task assignment
assignment.body: Check the assigned agent, team, and project. Restore or fix any missing, disabled, or incompatible settings, or choose an available assignee and save the task.

access.title: Access needs to be restored
access.body: Ask the owner or an administrator to restore access to the assigned agent, team, or project, or choose one you can access. Then save the task.

offline.title: Computer is unavailable
offline.body: Open Computers and reconnect the assigned computer. Queued tasks can be retried once it is ready.

provisioning.title: Waiting for computer setup
provisioning.body: Check setup progress in Computers. If setup fails, ask an administrator to investigate.

workspace.title: Workspace is unavailable
workspace.body: Restore the computer and workspace for this task, and check the directory, permissions, and mount. Moving the task to another computer may lose access to existing work.

capacity.title: Waiting for capacity
capacity.body: Wait for a running task to finish, or ask an administrator to add capacity on the assigned computer. Queued work can be retried when capacity frees up.

wip.title: Work-in-progress limit reached
wip.body: Finish, or review and accept, existing work on the task board to free a slot. Work awaiting acceptance also counts toward the limit.

ownership.title: Another run owns this work
ownership.body: Open the linked thread and let its run finish, or stop it there. Resolve any recovery before starting another run. Do not submit duplicate work.

retry_exhausted.title: Automatic retries have stopped
retry_exhausted.body: Check the recorded error and linked thread. Fix the underlying agent, access, or configuration problem before unblocking this task.

failure.title: Check why the run failed
failure.body: Read the recorded reason, task history, and linked thread. Depending on the error, check workspace access, agent sign-in, skill setup, and output. Keep any generated work. If a person stopped the run, confirm the work should resume.

human.title: Your input is needed
human.body: Reply in the linked thread. Your answer resumes this task.

review.title: Review the result
review.body: Open the linked thread and inspect the output and artifacts. Accept the work if it meets the requirements, or request changes with clear feedback.

manual_block.title: Task blocked manually
manual_block.body: Check the recorded reason with the person responsible. Unblocking restores the previous stage without starting an agent.

intro.title: How Relay works
intro.body: Three pieces, about five minutes to set up.
intro.relay_body: coordinates your work. Agents run on connected computers.
intro.computer_body: runs them: your laptop, or a computer your admin assigned you.
intro.agents_body: do the work in threads (conversations) and tasks (tracked work).

computer.label: Connect a computer
computer.title: Connect a computer
computer.body: A computer is where your agents run. Relay connects to it through a small background service.
computer.waiting: Waiting for your computer to connect…
computer.limit: Your organization manages computers. Ask an admin to assign you one, and this step completes automatically.
computer.no_runtime: {{name}} is connected but has no agent CLI ready. Install Claude Code, Codex, Pi, or Kimi, then refresh its runtimes.

agent.label: Create an agent
agent.title: Create your first agent
agent.body: An agent is a named identity with its own role and instructions. It uses one runtime (Claude Code, Codex, Pi, or Kimi) on one of your computers.

thread.label: Start a thread
thread.title: Start your first thread
thread.body: A thread is a conversation with your agents. They work in a shared workspace on the selected computer.
thread.starter: Look around this folder and write RELAY-TOUR.md summarizing what's here in five bullets.
thread.hint: It goes into the composer below. Edit it or write your own, then send. Output streams in, and the file appears when the run finishes.

explore.title: Your first run is done
explore.body: That’s the whole loop. Here’s where to go next.
explore.tasks_body: Track work and review results as tasks in a project.
explore.projects_body: Give several agents one shared workspace and a brief.
